@@ -0,0 +1,8 @@
+RELEASE_TYPE: minor
+
+Values recorded with :func:`~hypothesis.note` are now included in
+:ref:`observability <observability>` reports, as an ordered list of strings
+under the ``metadata.notes`` key of each test-case observation.  Previously,
+notes were only shown in the terminal for the |minimal failing test case|
+(or for every test case under |Verbosity.verbose|), and never appeared in
+observations at all.

+:func:`~hypothesis.note` values are also recorded, in order, under the
+``metadata.notes`` key of each test-case observation - whether or not they
+were printed to the terminal.
+

review_comments.body:
pretty sure this is going to double up on output - I had fable write this test:

```python
def test_debug_output_includes_notes(snapshot):
    # data.notes is only populated under observability, so the debug output
    # only includes notes when observability is enabled.
    @settings(
        SNAPSHOT_SETTINGS,
        verbosity=Verbosity.debug,
        phases=[Phase.generate],
        max_examples=1,
    )
    @given(st.just(0))
    def inner(x):
        note("hello")
        note("world")

    with capture_out() as out, capture_observations():
        inner()

    assert out.getvalue() == snapshot
```

and the output is

```
  Generating new test cases
  Test case: inner(
      x=0,
  )
  hello
  world
  0 choices -> Status.VALID
        ()
        hello
        world
  exit_with(max_examples)
  Run complete after 1 examples (1 valid) and 0 shrinks
```

I'd possibly just drop this tab-indented output?

---

also, I think I'd want to print events/target values alongside notes in this indented space, if we're going to keep the current branch's behavior of adding this print - `note` doesn't seem particularly special here relative to other info like `event` and `target`

```suggestion
                if runner.exit_reason is ExitReason.finished:
                    explanations.append(
                        "Hypothesis tried every possible input, so the "
                        "assumptions of this test are impossible to satisfy - "
                        "not merely unlikely - and running more test cases "
                        "cannot help."
```

we'll all have to get used to this!
can we just delete this `data.note` call? is it just for developer debugging? If not can it be replaced by the public API `note(v)`?

```suggestion
RELEASE_TYPE: minor

Values recorded with :func:`~hypothesis.note` are now included in
:ref:`observability <observability>` reports, as an ordered list of strings
under the ``metadata.notes`` key of each test-case observation.  Previously,
notes were only shown in the terminal for the minimal failing test case (or
for every test case under |Verbosity.verbose|), and never appeared in
observations at all.
```

this is pre-existing, but: I'd prefer to change this method to `note(self, value: str)` and make the string conversion the responsibility of the (currently single) caller. I want the ConjectureData API to be minimal and strict by default. (Note that it's already drifted; `repr` vs `pretty`).

I'd prefer to drop the `context.data.frozen` condition. It's possible adding this condition makes edge cases around `finally` more correct, but I don't recall us having a similar condition in other public APIs, and I'll take the consistent devil I know over adding one I don't.
